note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: coupons
datasets.select: SELECT id,coupon_id,status,term_begin_time,term_end_time,used_time,create_time FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: reservations
datasets.select: SELECT order_id,status,created_at,expires_at FROM coupon_reservation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY order_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_reservation WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: season_rewards
datasets.select: SELECT request_id,season_month,coupon_id,status,user_coupon_id,updated_at FROM season_reward_delivery WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY request_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM season_reward_delivery WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: exchanges
datasets.select: SELECT id,status,type,exchange_target_id,create_time,expired_time FROM exchange_code WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exchange_code WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
